name: Brown Butter Old Fashioned
description: Wheated bourbon, demerara and Angostura with four dashes of browned-butter fat wash. An Old Fashioned that tastes like the top of a pecan pie.
history: Fat-washing — infusing a spirit with butter or bacon fat, freezing and straining — has been a bar technique since the PDT Benton’s Old Fashioned in 2007. Fee Brothers’ 2026 water-soluble fat washes get the flavor in by the dash. A house build.
whyItWorks: Butter flavor rounds the bourbon’s edges and draws out its caramel; a wheated bourbon is already soft, so the two meet in the middle. Demerara adds molasses depth that white sugar wouldn’t.
steps: Stir the demerara with a barspoon of water in a mixing glass until dissolved.
Add bourbon, fat wash and bitters, fill with ice and stir until cold.
Strain over a large cube and express an orange peel over the top.
techniqueNotes: Start at three dashes of fat wash; four is rich, five tips into butterscotch.

recommendedBottles.rationale: Wheated and 100 proof: soft enough to meet the butter, strong enough not to vanish.
